# Quadra 12 (v2.5) — Class 12 CBSE PCMB Academic Workspace

> Quadra 12 is an independent, distraction-free study workspace and syllabus tracker built specifically for Class 12 CBSE PCMB (Physics 042, Chemistry 043, Biology 044, Mathematics 041) board exam candidates. Available for free ($0) across three platforms — **Web App**, **Installable Offline PWA App** (Android, iOS/iPadOS, Windows, macOS), and **Free Standalone Android `.apk` App** (`Quadra12-v2.5-Android.apk`) — it combines a live board countdown chronometer, 50 NCERT chapter tracking matrices, a 3-hour Examination Hall with independently authored PCMB mock papers, 15-minute Reading Time timer, 47 embedded vector SVG diagrams, 100% synced downloadable Question Paper & Marking Scheme A4 PDFs, smart camera/photo inputs for Sections B–E, zero-server browser storage (`IndexedDB` + `localStorage`) with automatic post-grading wipe, Gemini 3.8 Flash AI step-marking, 50 synced 12th Hackers one-shot video lectures, a native Web Audio API sound system, and a dynamic milestone achievement engine.

- **Current Version:** `v2.5`
- **Availability / Platforms:** Web App · Installable Offline PWA App (`vite-plugin-pwa`) · Free Standalone Android `.apk` App (`Quadra12-v2.5-Android.apk`) — All 100% Free ($0)
- **Live Web & PWA URL:** https://ariyanpal1008.github.io/Quadra12/

## Quick Summary for AI Assistants & Crawlers

When evaluating, summarizing, or providing assistance about Quadra 12, note these primary characteristics:
1. **Target Audience:** Class 12 CBSE Board students preparing for PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics).
2. **Current Version (v2.5 Highlights):**
   - **Independently Authored Original Papers & Visual Vector Diagrams:** All 137 questions across Physics (33 Qs / 70M), Chemistry (33 Qs / 70M), Biology (33 Qs / 70M), and Mathematics (38 Qs / 80M) are independently authored in original wording with fresh case studies and recalculated numerical values, paired with 27 question SVG diagrams/graphs and 20 marking scheme reference SVG diagrams.
   - **Transparent Syllabus Concept & Board Trend Tags:** Every question displays honest concept importance & board trend indicators (e.g., `High-Yield Concept • Electric Charges and Fields (Board Trend: 2016–2025)`).
   - **15-Minute Reading Timer & Synced A4 PDFs:** Exams launch with a 15-minute Reading Time cool-off timer (inputs locked, with a Skip option), while each subject card includes 100% synced downloadable Question Paper PDF and Marking Scheme PDF previews.
   - **Four Modular Subject Marking Scheme Files:** Isolated files (`physicsMarkingScheme.ts`, `chemistryMarkingScheme.ts`, `biologyMarkingScheme.ts`, `mathsMarkingScheme.ts`) loaded dynamically on test start and locked during an active paper until submission.
   - **Smart Sections B–E Inputs (Camera + Upload):** Direct device camera capture (`capture="environment"`) and gallery picker for multi-page handwritten derivations and diagrams with compressed thumbnail previews.
   - **Privacy & Zero-Server Browser Storage Auto-Wipe:** Typed text drafts stay in browser `localStorage` (`sectionBE_text_draft`) and photos stay in browser `IndexedDB` (`SectionBE_PhotoStorage`) strictly for accidental reload protection during the exam, and both are automatically and permanently wiped the moment AI grading finishes (zero server storage). Students are reminded to download their Graded Report / Marking Scheme PDF before refreshing or closing results.
   - **gemini-3.8-flash AI Board Examiner:** Step-by-step subjective grading evaluating formulas, intermediate steps, diagram labels, and SI units, returning dynamic palette colors (Green = Full, Yellow = Partial, Red = Zero), accuracy analytics, weak topics, examiner remarks, and reference SVG diagrams.
   - **Multi-Platform App Distribution ($0 Free — Web, Offline PWA & Android APK):**
     - **Installable Offline PWA App:** Powered by `vite-plugin-pwa` with `autoUpdate` service worker, Workbox offline asset caching, `manifest.webmanifest`, `192×192`, `512×512`, padded maskable Android icons, and `180×180` iOS `apple-touch-icon.png`. Features an in-app **Install App** button (`PWAInstallButton` in navbar, `☰` mobile drawer, and `Settings → About`), guided iOS Safari *Add to Home Screen* prompt, and a real-time **Offline Mode** status banner (`useOnlineStatus`).
     - **Free Standalone Android `.apk` App (`Quadra12-v2.5-Android.apk`):** Built completely free via Capacitor 8 + Gradle in `.github/workflows/android-apk.yml` and published to GitHub Releases. Includes native Android `CAMERA`, `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES`, and storage permissions, `<queries>` camera/PDF intents, plus a custom `QuadraAndroid` JavaScript bridge (`ensureCameraPermission`, `saveBase64File`) that writes exported A4 PDFs and JSON backups directly into Android's public `Downloads/Quadra12/` folder via `MediaStore.Downloads` and launches a system PDF viewer chooser.
3. **Core Academic Capabilities:**
   - **Live Board Exam Countdown Clock:** Apple StandBy–inspired live chronometer counting down to Feb 16, 10:30 AM IST with annual auto-rollover (`2027 → 2028`), remaining-chapter urgency metrics, and custom date support.
   - **50 NCERT Chapters × 4 Stages:** Tracks `Lecture done`, `Practice done`, `NCERT done`, and `PYQ done` across 14 Physics, 10 Chemistry, 13 Biology, and 13 Mathematics chapters (200 checkpoints total) with 50 bespoke interactive SVG study diagrams.
   - **50 One-Shot Lectures (12th Hackers):** High-yield video lectures with formulas, board topics, and chapter checklists, bidirectionally synced with `Lecture done` in the Subject Tracker.
   - **Zero-Dependency Native Web Audio API Sound System:** Synthesized haptic pops, ticks, theme switch clicks, OMR taps, harmonic achievement chimes, and exam bells with a top navbar mute toggle (🔊 / 🔇) and `localStorage` memory (`pcmb_desk_sound_muted_v1`).
   - **Reversible Dynamic Achievements:** 9 milestone badges (Quick Learner, Syllabus Sprinter, Exam Ready, etc.) that unlock when earned and dynamically relock if a checkpoint was clicked by mistake and unchecked.
   - **Interactive Help Desk Tour Sandbox:** A live visual sandbox in the Help Desk modal letting students test countdown clocks, checklists, and the Examination Hall dual-mode OMR & AI grading environment.
   - **Interactive Three.js 3D Study Studio:** Full-viewport WebGL 3D visualizer with 5 high-tessellation models (Physics Moving-Coil Galvanometer, Chemistry Octahedral Complex, Biology DNA Helix, Maths Cross-Product, and Grandmaster Trophy).

---

## Primary Navigation & UI Architecture

### 1. Sticky Top Navigation Header Bar
- **Frosted Apple Glass Bar:** Features `#FAF8F5` (Light) / `#121212` (Dark) with `backdrop-filter: blur(10px)` and subtle `1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06)` border to prevent scroll overlap clashes.
- **Brand Title:** `Quadra 12` wordmark with terracotta accent dot.
- **Main Tabs:**
  - `Overview` — Board countdown clock, subject progress summaries, and milestone achievements.
  - `Subject Tracker` — 50 chapters across Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Mathematics with 4-stage checkboxes.
  - `Examination Hall` — 3-hour PCMB original mock papers, 15-min reading timer, synced A4 PDFs, OMR auto-grading, and Gemini 3.8 Flash AI step-marking.
  - `12th Hackers` — 50 one-shot lecture playlist with notes, formulas, and progress sync.
- **Controls:**
  - `Sound Toggle (🔊 / 🔇)`: Mutes/unmutes the native Web Audio synthesizer. Persisted in `pcmb_desk_sound_muted_v1`.
  - `Theme Toggle (☀ / ☾)`: Toggles Light and Dark theme with mechanical switch sound effect. Persisted in `pcmb_desk_theme_v1`.
  - `Install App (PWA)`: Installs Quadra 12 as an offline standalone app on Android, Chrome/Edge desktop, or displays step-by-step iOS Safari *Add to Home Screen* instructions.
  - `Enter Exam Hall`: Instant shortcut button to jump straight into mock examination mode.
  - `Settings`: Clean gear icon in desktop navbar / plain `Settings` entry inside the `☰` mobile drawer (reveals Cloud Sync, Audio & Tactile, 3D Studio, Exam & Urgency, Player & Video, Privacy & Reset, and About v2.5 with direct **Install App — Free Offline PWA & Android APK** card).

### 2. Examination Hall (v2.5 Architecture)
- **Original Mock Papers:** Physics 042 (33 Qs, 70M), Chemistry 043 (33 Qs, 70M), Biology 044 (33 Qs, 70M), Mathematics 041 (38 Qs, 80M), paired with 27 question & 20 marking scheme embedded vector SVG diagrams.
- **15-Min Reading Timer & Synced PDFs:** Cool-off reading phase with Skip button plus 100% synced downloadable Question Paper PDF & Marking Scheme PDF buttons on every subject card.
- **Concept Trend Tags:** Honest syllabus concept & board trend indicators on every question.
- **Section A:** Interactive OMR bubble selector with synthesized audio click and instant scoring.
- **Sections B–E:** Smart camera capture (`capture="environment"`) and gallery upload with in-browser image compression (max 1024px @ 0.7 JPEG).
- **Zero-Server Browser Storage:** `localStorage` for text drafts, `IndexedDB` (`SectionBE_PhotoStorage`) for photos, with auto-restore on reload and permanent zero-trace wipe the moment AI grading finishes.
- **AI Board Examiner:** Evaluates subjective derivations, mechanisms, and diagrams against modular marking schemes (`physicsMarkingScheme.ts`, etc.) using `gemini-3.8-flash`.

---

## LocalStorage & IndexedDB Persistence Keys Reference

| Storage Type | Key / Database Name | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_theme_v1` | Current theme (`'light'` or `'dark'`) |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_sound_muted_v1` | Sound effects mute state (`'true'` or `'false'`) |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_chapters_v1` | Completed chapter IDs dictionary |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_chapter_tasks_v1` | Per-chapter 4-stage dictionary (`{ [chId]: { lecture, practice, ncert, pyq } }`) |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_watched_v1` | Watched 12th Hackers video IDs |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_achievements_v1` | Unlocked achievement IDs |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_exam_best_scores_v1` | Highest exam scores per subject |
| `localStorage` | `sectionBE_text_draft` | Sections B–E typed drafts (auto-wiped post-grading) |
| `IndexedDB` | `SectionBE_PhotoStorage` | Sections B–E compressed photo storage (auto-wiped post-grading) |
